title: Redline

authorization.quote: Can you create three more 'surprise me' versions of it please?
authorization.scope: One take per concept, three original instrumental takes total and separate local David previews.

prompt: An original 18-second instrumental industrial rave-metal advertising cue at 160 BPM, upbeat, rebellious and propulsive, with a fierce four-on-the-floor kick, distorted syncopated guitar bursts, a snarling acid-synth bassline and a catchy rising synth hook, tightly produced with controlled sub-bass. Launch on the first beat, alternate guitar and acid-synth responses with evolving percussion every two bars, create a brief half-beat stop around 7 seconds and a new rhythmic variation afterward; maintain clear space for a low spoken voice through 12.5 seconds, then open into the fullest hook with brighter chords and end on a clean emphatic two-hit signature at 18 seconds. Strictly instrumental with no singing, spoken words, chants, choir or vocal samples, no long build-up, static repeated loop or fade-out.
seed_note: No seed requested; preserve any seed returned.

parameters.name: lyrics_type
parameters.description: How lyrics are handled: auto-generated, custom-provided, or instrumental only.

parameters.name: lyrics
parameters.description: Custom lyrics text or a reference to a text node's output. Ignored when lyrics_type is 'instrumental'.

creative_direction.description: Industrial rave-metal with acid synth, guitar bursts and a rising final hook
creative_direction.user_feedback_addressed: Earlier jingle sounds repetitive during narration; request evolving drums, call-and-response and a brief break rather than one unchanged loop.
creative_direction.reference_usage: Text description only, no reference song uploaded or sampled.

review.checks: MP3 format verified and decoded successfully; preview source/output hashes verified, narration prefix byte-identical to liked metal preview; same source voice gain and fixed master; zero full-scale PCM samples.
review.listening_limitations: Genre, tempo, arrangement development, catchiness and absence of vocal artifacts are requested qualities, not independent assistant listening findings. Approximate source RMS matching is not perceptual LUFS matching or final picture alignment.
review.source_preservation: Locked David, prior music and prior previews remain byte-identical.
review.publication: No final public music share link or contest submission.
